decision: Stop both final4k endpoints; no extension or promotion. V99 misses the fixed photo PSNR gain threshold, lowers ADC photographic SSIM and does not repair positive-noise native fabric color/detail. Common projected inference improves ADC fabric for both arms; this is not a V99-specific trained advantage. Keep V43 as the working reference.
scope: Complete fixed development study and actual native/GFX review, one training seed. Independent scalar/array audits reuse saved outputs, no new inference or noise. Real camera AHD and separately captured ISO100 GFX references are not exact GT. No SOTA, broad real-photo RawNIND superiority, new full100MP precision/speed or100MP/10s qualification. Full project goal remains unmet.
